generalAbilities.name: Blood Scent
generalAbilities.description: A mandragora can smell creatures with blood as an imprecise sense at a range of 30 feet, and it can smell demons, fey, and sorcerers with blood as a precise sense at a range of 30 feet.

defensiveAbilities.name: Fast Healing 15
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A monster with this ability regains the given number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn.

defensiveAbilities.name: Vulnerability to Supernatural Darkness
defensiveAbilities.description: Whenever a mandragora begins its turn in an area of magical darkness, it is Slowed 1 on that turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Blood Drain
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An enemy takes damage from the mandragora swarm's Swarming Bites action

Effect The mandragora swarm drains blood from the creature, dealing 9d6 damage. If the creature is a demon, fey, or sorcerer, the mandragora gains temporary Hit Points equal to the damage dealt. A creature that has its blood drained by a mandragora is Drained 2 until it receives healing of any kind or amount.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mandragora Swarm Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 40 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 4d6 Poison Damage damage and Stupefied 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 4d6 Poison Damage damage, Confused, and stupefied 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 6d6 Poison Damage damage, confused, and stupefied 1 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Piercing Shriek
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect The mandragora emits an unsettling shriek. Each non-mandragora creature within 30 feet must attempt a DC 40 Will Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Sickened 1.

Failure The creature is Sickened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Sickened 2 and Slowed 1. As long as the creature remains sickened, this slowed condition value can't be reduced below 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swarming Bites
offensiveAbilities.description: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 7d8 Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 40 Reflex Saving Throw) and is exposed to mandragora swarm venom. A successful save negates the poison exposure.
